en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a textile display booth. Rolls of fabric are stacked vertically and horizontally, with several textile products such as folded linens and bolts on display in the foreground. Above the display, a large sign reads '40' in a black diamond, and Cyrillic text is present, including the word 'Текстиль' (Textile) and the city 'Варна' (Varna). The photo has a vintage appearance, likely from the early to mid-20th century.
